integrity: The analytical proof covers all path lengths and all injective first-K spectral evolutions. Exact polynomial identities and finite-matrix comparisons are supplementary, not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Only the first K=2,3,4 normalized-path modes, K consecutive observations at one fixed vertex, and determinant optimality; no minimal-eigenvalue or general-K theorem. Complete motivating preprint inaccessible; possible prior overlap is residual risk.
title: Sharp low-bandwidth path-sensor phase diagram for three temporal frames
